messages.threadName: why did the migration job skip
messages.content: Check the job's skip condition first. The job is skipped when the schema version already matches the target.

messages.threadName: how do I pin the migration image tag
messages.content: Read the tag from one build arg and pass the same value to both jobs. Two sources is how drift starts.

messages.threadName: why did the migration job skip
messages.content: It matched, so the skip was correct. Decision: I will print the recorded schema version in the job log so this is obvious next time.

messages.threadName: how do I pin the migration image tag
messages.content: Decision: pin the tag in the deploy manifest, not in the shell, because the shell path runs on a developer laptop.
